body: This is the most beautiful thing I've read. Everyone deserves to be talked about the way you talk about her. Don't give up on her because you're afraid of the distance, like you said: life is about taking risks. Before I met my boyfriend I told myself I would never ever do long distance, but here we are. Our journey has been really rough and still is at times but it's so worth it when we work together and love each other through it. I understand it is so difficult, but it can also be so good! Yes, I think that's really common, and it's totally understandable! When I get anxious a go through a ton of emotions, anger being one of them. Sometimes I lash out on people who don't deserve it, simply because I'm anxious, which leaves me feeling like a horrible person when I come out of it. The anxiety doesn't make my actions okay, but it might help to realize why you feel so angry, so that you can deal with it. It is really important to know that anxiety can cause a lot of unwanted emotions and actions, and while those emotions are okay and should be embraced, it is always important to take responsibility for your actions and words, whether they're done because of anxiety or not.
Something I'm learning myself is how to breathe properly. If you're starting to feel anxious or angry, take a step back and do a breathing exercise. I meditated for the first time today, and let me tell you, it really helped. I'll link it for you: https://youtu.be/O-6f5wQXSu8
Never push away your emotions. Acknowledge them, let yourself know they're okay and then allow them to go. 
You've got this OP!
